item.title: Valuation AI Briefing - Fri 13 Nov 2026: Are an expert's AI prompts discoverable?
item.description:
Two federal courts split on whether expert witnesses' AI prompts are discoverable (CLF v. Shell and Villanueva v. LVMPD); Doximity's physician AI survey and what it means for FMV work; Concentrate AI's HIPAA gateway; HCCA's AI-enabled, expert-led FMV workflow; PitchBook's scheduled agents and Data MCP; 73 Strings Extraction Agent; Blue J's $176M Series E; and Numica's AI-native accounting roll-up.

Sources discussed:

  • Federal Court Splits On Disclosure Of Expert Witness AI Prompts (Mayer Brown via Legal 500)
  • Conservation Law Foundation v. Shell: expert AI prompts (The Expert Record)
  • More Than Half of U.S. Physicians Now Use AI In Their Practice Daily (Doximity via Business Wire)
  • Concentrate AI Launches HIPAA-Compliant AI Gateway With One BAA (ACCESS Newswire)
  • The future of healthcare compensation valuation: AI-enabled, expert-led (HCCA Compliance Today)
  • AI and FMV: Balancing Innovation with Professional Judgment (ECG Management Consultants)
  • PitchBook's Year of Platform Innovation (PitchBook)
  • 73 Strings Unveils Extraction Agent (73 Strings)
  • Tax Research Platform Blue J Raises $176M (LawSites)
  • Toronto's Blue J raises $176-million (The Globe and Mail)
  • Numica Raises $21M to Roll Up America's Retiring Accounting Firms (GlobeNewswire)

item.title: Valuation AI Briefing - Thu 12 Nov 2026: Experts must declare their AI
item.description:
The UK Civil Justice Council's AI declaration for experts and Mrs Justice Joanna Smith's checklist; the Gillespie 'thought partner' ruling; the Bond Solon expert witness survey; AI in CMS's 2027 payment rules; the AICPA FVS AI Implementation Framework; and two tools, Dayshape Agent and ZAAN's simulated cross-examination of valuation experts.

Sources discussed:

  • CJC final report on AI and court documents: declarations for witnesses and experts (Lewis Silkin)
  • Speech by Mrs Justice Joanna Smith: Artificial Intelligence and Expert Evidence (Courts and Tribunals Judiciary)
  • Even With an Error, Expert's "Troubling" Use of AI as a "Thought Partner" Did Not Undermine Expert Opinion (EDRM)
  • C.A.: No Error in Allowing Expert to Testify About Report Generated With Help of AI (California Courts Newsroom)
  • Bond Solon/Gazette Expert Witness Survey 2026: key takeaways (Law Gazette)
  • AI uncertainty clouds expert evidence (New Law Journal)
  • Cornwall Council v M and F [2026] EWFC 306: A Reminder on the Use of AI (Deka Chambers)
  • Digital Health and AI: Key Regulatory, Reimbursement and Policy Developments (BakerHostetler)
  • BlueVal Partner Contributes to AICPA's AI Implementation Framework for FVS Practices (BlueVal Group)
  • AI Implementation Framework for FVS Practices (AICPA & CIMA)
  • Introducing Dayshape Agent (Dayshape)
  • Simulation 1.4: Cross-examining the financial expert (ZAAN)
